scopeNotes.tax: Original estimated approval includes net HST. Public updated estimate displays 4.286% net HST and 1% overhead against a subtotal of $8,382,092.44; arithmetic reproduces printed cents. Currency code not explicitly stated.
scopeNotes.sourceArithmetic: Original letter components sum $8,825,170 against printed $8,825,000. Updated pre-decision estimate in public H-2 has cents sum $8,825,169.84; nearest-thousand rounding reproduces printed total. Final funding line says ROUNDED, but total rounding rule remains an inference. No extra spending or overrun is established.
scopeNotes.laterBudget: Staff report project budget $9,805,000 has unreconciled scope relative to this original approval. Later amendments, revised scope and budget basis were not established.
scopeNotes.laterCumulativeSpend: Staff report cumulative expenditure remains a distinct measure; no subtraction against original approval as an overrun, loss or unlawful expenditure is supported.
scopeNotes.approvalScope: Approval covers request and proposed funding plan based on information provided. Letter describes required CN cost-sharing and HRM street-work sharing; does not establish subsequent execution or payment.
scopeNotes.delivery: Construction timing was planned, not independent proof of completion or acceptance.
scopeNotes.coverage: Only this one original decision letter verified; other reported matters remain references unless separately reviewed.
scopeNotes.researchGap: The public H-1/H-2 records clarify the original approval estimate, not the later $9,805,000 project-budget basis. A dated approved budget revision, project ledger reconciliation or explicitly linked later regulatory decision is still needed; none is inferred from this bounded review.

attribution: Institutional facts attributed to the Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board decision letter and Halifax Water staff report. No endorsement implied; full source document republication rights not established.

versionHistory.change: Add exact public H-1/H-2 scope and updated estimate evidence; clarify percentage bases and rounding inference. Original approval, parent linkage and later-budget unknown status unchanged.

approvalScopeSupplement.updateBasis: IR-9 and IR-10 explicitly direct the reader to the July 13 updated estimate to reconcile the older application attachment and separate-funding differences. This is a pre-decision estimate update, not a later amendment to the August 22 approval.
approvalScopeSupplement.percentageBasisStatus: Arithmetic inference from displayed subtotals and percentages, reproducing printed cents; not an independently quoted tax-policy rule.
approvalScopeSupplement.roundingStatus: Final funding line explicitly says ROUNDED. Rounding the pre-deduction cents sum to nearest thousand reproduces printed total, but exact rounding rule for the total is inferred, not expressly stated.
